description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ihalayagoda, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District (25/55049)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property and providing detailed land parcel information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, and land extents. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns property ownership, land registration, and title settlement processes under the Registration of Title Act.
